assessment: SEOasis presents a focused Shopify growth system: transactional collections, schema, hub-and-spoke linking, Reddit and AI monitoring, with organic Shopping visible in case evidence and founder commentary. I would work inside that model: agree the commercial baseline, ship a small batch with QA, measure by cohort and revise the account plan at 90 days. The public review supports a few modest editorial/template tests; it cannot establish account results or a forecast.

scores.name: Technical foundation
scores.scope: Agency-site public HTML sample only. Checks describe observed controls, not indexation, Core Web Vitals or traffic performance.

criteria.label: Sampled pages respond successfully
criteria.evidence: 20/20 sampled pages returned final HTTP 200.

criteria.label: Public discovery controls are accessible
criteria.evidence: robots.txt allows / and declares a 70-URL XML sitemap.

criteria.label: Index directives and primary headings are present
criteria.evidence: 20/20 sampled pages expose index, follow and one H1 in source HTML; actual indexing remains unknown.

criteria.label: Preferred URL signals are consistent in the sample
criteria.evidence: The case hub and three sampled case studies lack a source-HTML canonical; Google-selected canonicals were not checked.

scores.name: Search intent coverage
scores.scope: Agency-site public topic coverage only. No search volume, ranking, competitive difficulty or cannibalization score is implied.

criteria.label: Core commercial service destinations exist

criteria.label: Buyer education supports the offering
criteria.evidence: Audit, Shopify implementation and agency-selection guides exist.

criteria.label: Adjacent acquisition themes have public coverage
criteria.evidence: Reddit service content and an organic Shopping case are available.

criteria.label: Distinct roles across close page variants are substantiated
criteria.evidence: Near-synonym service URLs and overlapping guide themes warrant a page-role review; query ownership was not established.

scores.name: Ecommerce architecture

criteria.label: Transactional clusters guide collection work

criteria.label: Collections are presented as shopping destinations

criteria.label: Parent and supporting relationships are documented

criteria.label: An audit-to-review operating sequence is described
criteria.evidence: Public method includes foundations, buildout and 90-day recalibration.

criteria.evidence: Representative service, guide and proof pages provide source metadata.

strengths.title: A specific Shopify buyer and commercial goal
strengths.summary: Positioning connects product discovery with ecommerce revenue.
strengths.evidence: Homepage qualifies Shopify brands above $100K/month and names AI/search product discovery.
strengths.action: Keep the account goal tied to qualified demand, stock and profitable orders.

strengths.title: A recognizable collection-first method
strengths.summary: Transactional clusters, real product grids and hub-and-spoke links form a coherent delivery model.
strengths.evidence: Homepage and Shopify method explicitly describe these connected workstreams.
strengths.action: Use that language in collection briefs and release QA.

strengths.title: Complementary acquisition workstreams
strengths.summary: Public method spans on-site work, Reddit and organic Shopping.
strengths.evidence: Reddit is a named pillar; the Shopping case and founder interview describe feeds and presentation tests.
strengths.action: Give each channel its own evidence log and measurement definition.

strengths.title: Named people and accessible proof
strengths.summary: Founder, team and client case studies make expertise concrete.
strengths.evidence: Public homepage identifies operators and the case library covers several intervention types; results are company-reported.
strengths.action: Preserve dates, scope and attribution caveats when reusing proof.

strengths.title: A clear ownership and review cadence
strengths.summary: The role and public promises connect delivery with communication and quarterly revision.
strengths.evidence: Role describes account ownership; homepage states Friday reports, fortnightly calls and 90-day recalibration.
strengths.action: Show one accountable plan, release log and next-quarter decision per account.

topOpportunities.title: Make a compact release QA pack
topOpportunities.summary: Start with a few directly observed editorial/template checks.
topOpportunities.evidence: Repeated title branding, one incomplete description and two dated implementation references are verified in the bounded review.
topOpportunities.action: Batch fixes by template, verify published output and preserve a change log; no traffic lift is promised.

topOpportunities.title: Test restrained paths from methodology to proof
topOpportunities.summary: Help a prospective client move between a useful service explanation and relevant evidence.
topOpportunities.evidence: Homepage HTML has no commercial-service link in the sample; existing service-to-case and content-to-commercial links already provide a base.
topOpportunities.action: Validate the full graph and conversion intent, then pilot one hub link and a few contextual proof links.

topOpportunities.title: Give close page variants an explicit job
topOpportunities.summary: Validate intent ownership before changing useful pages.
topOpportunities.evidence: Near-synonym service URLs and two Shopify optimization guides have overlapping themes; no performance harm is established.
topOpportunities.action: Join query × page evidence, qualified outcomes and page purpose; retain, differentiate or consolidate only after review.

topOpportunities.title: Pilot collections with commercial release gates
topOpportunities.summary: Demonstrate the role using one client cluster, then scale only a viable pattern.
topOpportunities.evidence: SEOasis documents transactional collection buildout; this study has no client assortment, margin or query data.
topOpportunities.action: Check distinct intent, available products, margin, URL policy, copy, links, schema and mobile purchase flow before launch.

topOpportunities.title: Make evidence drive the day-90 decision
topOpportunities.summary: Connect shipping, search response and commercial outcomes in one account record.
topOpportunities.evidence: Public reporting cadence exists; reconciled account metrics and repeatable AI outputs were not provided.
topOpportunities.action: Agree definitions, save cohort baselines and AI observations, then decide keep, expand, revise or stop with the client.

internalValidation.title: Query ownership and actual indexation
internalValidation.metric: Page indexing, selected-canonical samples and query × landing-page clicks/impressions/CTR by market/device.
internalValidation.why: Public HTTP access and similar URLs cannot establish indexing or cannibalization.
internalValidation.decision: Retain, differentiate, consolidate or repair an affected cohort.

internalValidation.title: Viable and profitable collection priorities
internalValidation.metric: Available assortment, stock, product overlap, net category sales, returns, margin and query opportunity.
internalValidation.why: Intent is valuable only when a merchant can fulfill it profitably.
internalValidation.decision: Build, improve, defer or consolidate a collection; agree capacity.

internalValidation.title: Tracking and commercial attribution
internalValidation.metric: Purchase/refund event integrity, transaction-ID reconciliation, landing-cohort purchases, net sales and new-customer revenue.
internalValidation.why: Channel attribution, net revenue and incremental lift answer different questions.
internalValidation.decision: Repair measurement first; prioritize cohorts using comparable commercial definitions.

internalValidation.title: Free-listing eligibility and outcomes
internalValidation.metric: Disapproved/limited items, feed attribute issues, free-listing clicks/CTR and reconciled purchases.
internalValidation.why: A presentation test cannot be interpreted without feed health, stock and channel definitions.
internalValidation.decision: Repair blockers, select a product cohort and stop or scale the feed test.

internalValidation.title: AI, community and earned-mention evidence
internalValidation.platform: Saved AI outputs / AI tools + approved community log + GSC or licensed backlink tools
internalValidation.metric: Repeated prompt outputs and exact citations; genuine mentions and source-level relevant links; qualified referrals measured separately.
internalValidation.why: Public service messaging does not establish observed AI visibility or causal community effects.
internalValidation.decision: Validate or revise each hypothesis; avoid a combined visibility percentage or fabricated authority metric.

quickWins: Remove repeated title branding through shared-template QA.
Complete the sampled agency-selection meta description.
Refresh FID and retired parameter-tool guidance against current primary documentation.
After rendered-graph review, test a small number of useful methodology-to-proof links.
mediumTerm: Build a query-to-page ownership matrix before retaining, differentiating or consolidating variants.
Pilot one commercially viable Shopify collection cluster with a full release gate.
Connect feed health, collection cohorts and agreed revenue definitions to the reporting cadence.
strategicBets: Run a repeated AI query panel with saved conditions and exact citations.
Test feed titles and images as separate, comparable product-cohort releases.
Turn approved experiment evidence into reusable briefs, SOPs and expert commentary.
assessmentSummary: SEOasis has a focused Shopify playbook: transactional collections, supporting structure, community authority, and measurement. I would make the execution visible: baseline, prioritize, ship with QA, measure by cohort, and recalibrate every 90 days.
